name: “God, I’m walking into a shift where one mistake could cost

lines.ref:
“God, I’m walking into a shift
where one mistake could cost my license.

I don’t know what to do next”

audit.notes: While the opening shot could be substituted with a stressed clip at a laptop, the payoff relies on a custom series of photos showing highlighted passages in a physical Bible or book centered on a keyword ('Trust').
audit.summary: A stressed healthcare worker in scrubs sits with his head in his hands before a shift, followed by a rapid montage of Bible verses highlighting the word 'Trust'.
